name: Bauxite Pidgin
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid record baux1234 (HTML page and JSON: classification Pidgin > French-based pidgin; country GN; jsondata.meds = [309660, a wordlist or less, Perexvalskaya 2008]); reference record 309660 (.bib).
sources.note: No stress information; only identifies Perexvalskaya 2008 as the sole (minimal) description.

sources.citation: Перехвальская, Е. В. 2008. Русские пиджины. СПб.: Алетейя. 363 с. ISBN 978-5-91419-131-0 (Glottolog ref 309660, its Glottolog's most extensive description for baux1234; listed by Glottolog as an overview;minimal). Section «Бокситский язык», Часть II «Материал», pp. 211–216 of the author's PDF (249 pp; print pagination differs).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress. Only phonetic remark (p. 212, item 4): the jargon combines French lexicon with Russian phonetics/phonology; the anonymous typescript's preface says «произношение простое», glossed as 'fully follows the rules of Russian phonetics'; French diphthongs pronounced as two vowels. No 'ударение'/'акцент' anywhere in the section; the 110-item corpus (pp. 213–215) is in Cyrillic with no stress marks; grammar notes (pp. 215–216) cover pronouns, word order, verbs, number, lexicon only.

sources.citation: Anonymous. [1970s]. «Словарь бокситского народного языка (общие систематизированные сведения)». Typescript, 8 pp., author and place unknown; scanned copies circulated privately/online among Russian bauxite specialists in Guinea.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: The only primary source; Perekhvalskaya reproduces its corpus but not the full preface («произношение простое»), which is the one place a remark on stress could exist.

sources.citation: Anonymous, 1970s. «Словарь бокситского народного языка (общие систематизированные сведения)». Typescript, 8 pp., author and place unknown (cited by Perekhvalskaya 2008 as «Бокситский язык б. г.», bibliography p. ~239 of PDF; its full corpus is reproduced on pp. 213–215).
